dct_description_sm: The Decima Quarterly is a survey of public attitudes of Canadians on a wide range of matters related to public affairs, which was conducted every three months from the first quarter of 1980 until the first quarter of 1995. Each survey involves interviews of some 150+ questions with a random sample size of 1,500 Canadian citizens.
